question: Tell me about a time you faced a significant challenge at work and how you handled it.
intendedUser: Technology professional with 1-3 years of experience
description: Behavioral question assessing problem-solving and resilience under pressure.
purposeOfQuestion: The interviewer evaluates the candidate's ability to identify problems, take initiative, and demonstrate learning from difficult situations.
exampleAnswer: When I was a junior developer at TechSolutions, I inherited a legacy module that frequently crashed during peak hours. The situation was critical as it affected our main client's operations. I took ownership, analysed the logs, discovered a race condition in the caching layer, and refactored the code with proper synchronization. I also implemented automated tests to prevent regression. Result: crashes reduced by 90% and deployment confidence improved significantly.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Taking credit for team achievements alone
No mention of lessons learned or preventive measures
evaluationCriteria: STAR structure completeness, clarity of personal contribution, evidence of learning, specificity of metrics or outcomes
